subject: Medford Brewing Company Pouring Permit
overview: The commission elected a new chair following a long-time member's retirement and approved several one-day and permanent liquor licenses for local events and businesses.

items.title: Minutes and Commission Transition
items.summary: The commission approved meeting minutes from March, welcomed new member Robert Delafano, and bid farewell to retiring chair Jim after 25 years of service.

items.title: Election of Commission Chair
items.summary: The commission elected Allan Martorana to serve as the new Chair.

items.title: West Medford Events One-Day License
items.summary: Approved a one-day wine and malt license for a May 22 cornhole tournament at Duggar Park, with the condition that the applicant provide a site diagram and confirm last call by 6:30 p.m.

items.title: House Bear Brewing Farmer's Winery License
items.summary: Approved a license for the sale and sampling of mead and cider at the Medford Farmers Market for the 2022 season.

items.title: Medford Brewing Company One-Day Licenses
items.summary: Approved two one-day licenses for the June 18 'Circle the Square' event and the June 25 'West Medford Open Studios' event at Duggar Park.

items.title: Medford Brewing Company Pouring Permit
items.summary: Approved a farmer-brewery pouring permit for 30 Harvard Avenue, conditional on the submission of an updated seating plan and clarification of parking arrangements for neighbors.
